youtube.title: The Extra Hole On Your Running Shoes 👟 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Many running shoes have one extra eyelet at the top that most people leave empty. It lets you tie a heel lock, also called a runner's loop: the lace forms a small loop on each side and pulls the shoe snugly around the ankle. That keeps the heel from lifting and the foot from sliding forward, which can reduce blisters and bruised toenails on long downhill runs.
